acceptance_criteria.statement: ExecuteApprovedProposal runs current Workspace/resource authorization, ExecutionAuthorizer and exact capability/binding/policy compatibility before acquisition and reruns them after AcquireApplied immediately before provider invocation. A post-acquisition denial records sanitized before_provider_receive under the current lease, makes zero provider calls, remains executing and returns ExecutionIndeterminate HTTP 202 without blind retry authority.

ExternalResourceReferenceVerifier verifies the exact approved m4r1 key, expiry, Workspace, capability version and binding before acquisition and again in the post-acquisition current check; every denial produces zero provider calls.

The server computes one immutable canonical-json-v1 request fingerprint over operation, exact capability/binding/reference claims and normalized title/description, paired with the proposal's immutable logical execution identity.

ToolActionStore.acquire_execution uses PostgreSQL transaction time and typed CAS to atomically create generation 1, owner/deadline, executing state, append-only audit and an AuthorizedExecutionBindingSnapshot without raw provider ID.
Concurrent execution acquisition has exactly one applied winner; losers return a typed in-progress, conflict or non-executable projection and make no provider call.

Observation and finalization require the current owner, exact generation and unexpired lease. Issue #77 proves wrong-owner, wrong-generation and expired generation-1 fencing; durable higher-generation takeover and post-takeover stale-owner fencing remain Issue #78.

The SQLite provider receives the immutable logical ID/fingerprint and atomically commits its externally visible ticket mutation or definitive rejection with the authoritative idempotency fingerprint/outcome in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Same fingerprint replays, different fingerprint conflicts, and faults before/after commit cannot duplicate the logical side effect.
Direct provider success finalizes succeeded; only target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected are definitive failures that finalize failed and map to sanitized TOOL_PROVIDER_FAILURE.

Receipt-possible outcomes remain executing and return ExecutionIndeterminate HTTP 202. Same-logical-ID/different-fingerprint is a distinct non-terminal ProviderIdempotencyConflict: lifecycle remains executing, public mapping is HTTP 409 TOOL_PROVIDER_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, audit is sanitized, no provider retry is allowed and Issue #78 may only observe provider truth without converting the mismatch to a terminal outcome or write authority.

Execution actor, both current authorization/compatibility decisions, lease generation, provider identity, immutable binding/fingerprint/logical ID, observations and outcome are reconstructable from append-only audit while M1-M3 regressions remain green.

design_decisions.decision: Proposal actor, approval actor and execution authority are distinct. Current authorization and exact compatibility are checked both before acquisition and after acquisition at the last deterministic barrier before provider invocation.

Material capability, Workspace-to-external-scope binding or policy mismatch is stale and requires a new proposal/approval; temporary execution denial may leave the proposal approved, and a denial after acquisition uses the conservative before-provider-receive non-terminal path.
PostgreSQL owns lifecycle/lease/audit. SQLite owns independent external state and idempotency, committing the effect and outcome atomically in one transaction.

Lifecycle remains executing until definitive success or one of three closed failures. Indeterminate receipt and fingerprint conflict are typed non-terminal observations with separate 202 and 409 public projections.

Issue #77 owns generation-1 acquisition and exact-owner/generation/deadline fencing only. ReconcileExecution, stale-lease takeover, higher generations and post-takeover stale-owner proof remain Issue #78.

invariants: Both authorization/compatibility checkpoints precede provider invocation; every denial path has zero provider calls.
The approved capability version and Workspace-to-external-scope binding never silently retarget or upgrade.
Logical execution identity and request fingerprint are server-derived, immutable and never client input.
Provider ticket/rejection state and idempotency fingerprint/outcome commit atomically or both roll back.
A provider fingerprint conflict never becomes false success/failed and never grants retry authority.
Capability registry remains static and typed; no plugin framework or dynamic discovery is introduced.
No model/system actor approves, approval grants no execution authority, and raw provider IDs/errors never enter public/audit projections.
out_of_scope: ReconcileExecution, stale-lease takeover, generation 2+ and post-takeover stale-owner recovery, owned by Issue #78.
A vendor-backed production integration; deterministic SQLite is the M4 reference-provider release boundary.
Dynamic plugins, capability discovery or a general plugin framework.
Editing immutable proposals or reusing approval after material capability, binding or policy change.

test_cases.statement: Use an ordered barrier after AcquireApplied to revoke authority or change exact compatibility before provider invocation.
test_cases.oracle: The second current check denies, records before_provider_receive under the current lease, returns non-terminal 202, performs zero provider calls and grants no blind retry.

test_cases.statement: Forge, expire and cross-bind m4r1 references, including key/version cases, at both current checkpoints.
test_cases.oracle: Every integrity/scope/version failure is typed and occurs before provider invocation with zero provider calls.

test_cases.statement: Attempt client logical-ID/fingerprint input and independently recompute canonical-json-v1 across normalized parameters.
test_cases.oracle: Only the server-derived immutable logical ID/fingerprint is stored and sent to the provider.

test_cases.statement: Race concurrent acquire_execution calls in PostgreSQL-backed composition.
test_cases.oracle: Exactly one generation-1 winner/audit exists and every loser produces zero provider calls.

test_cases.statement: Against one current generation-1 lease, attempt observation/finalization with wrong owner, wrong generation and expired deadline.
test_cases.oracle: Every mismatch is ExecutionFenced and cannot alter outcome; no generation-2 fixture or takeover is implemented in #77.

test_cases.statement: Run concurrent/repeated SQLite create_ticket calls and inject before_atomic_commit and after_atomic_commit_before_ack faults.
test_cases.oracle: Effect plus ledger both roll back before commit or both persist after commit; same fingerprint replays one outcome, different fingerprint conflicts and no second ticket is created.

test_cases.statement: Exercise direct success and each of the three closed terminal failure codes.
test_cases.oracle: Only those outcomes finalize succeeded/failed with sanitized audit and exact HTTP mapping.

test_cases.statement: Exercise timeout, ack loss, unavailable, malformed/unknown, before-provider-receive interruption and provider fingerprint conflict.
test_cases.oracle: Receipt-possible/before-receive cases are executing/202 with no blind retry; fingerprint conflict is executing/409 with no provider retry and sanitized audit.

test_cases.statement: Reload PostgreSQL and SQLite independently after direct, indeterminate and conflict observations.
test_cases.oracle: Authority/binding/lease/provider/observation/outcome fields and atomic provider ledger reconstruct exactly without raw provider IDs.

test_cases.statement: Run focused M4.3 tests, full pytest, Ruff, Compose and clean Alembic migration.
test_cases.oracle: All exact-candidate M4.3 checks and M1-M3 regressions are green.

command_projections.statement: Clean PostgreSQL recreation and Alembic upgrade with pinned runtime.
Focused #77 and full repository pytest with worktree-pinned PYTHONPATH.
Ruff and Docker Compose configuration verification.

required_evidence.statement: Ordered two-check authority/reference/compatibility/acquisition/provider traces and zero-call denial counts.
Generation-1 PostgreSQL lease/CAS/fencing and append-only audit reconstruction.
Atomic SQLite ticket/rejection plus idempotency transaction rows, fault injection, replay/conflict and independent restart evidence.
Sanitized terminal, indeterminate, before-receive and fingerprint-conflict HTTP/result matrix with retry prohibition.
Exact subject SHA, focused/full totals, Ruff/Compose exits, clean Alembic head and clean status.

prior_findings.required_change: Define the second check, denial projection and barrier test.

prior_findings.problem: Provider effect and idempotency outcome atomicity was not explicit in the packet.
prior_findings.required_change: Bind both to one atomic SQLite transaction and inject faults around commit.
Define non-terminal executing/409, sanitized audit and no-retry/#78 observation semantics.

prior_findings.problem: The #77 test seam implied a higher generation owned by #78.
prior_findings.required_change: Limit #77 to generation-1 fencing and defer takeover/post-takeover proof to #78.
